description: This file provides zsh shell completions and wrapper functions for the 'git' command, including configuration for bash completion integration, custom completion functions, and command aliasing.

methods.name: emulate
methods.description: Set the emulation mode for the shell (ksh, zsh, etc).

methods.name: compadd
methods.description: Add completion matches to the current completion list.

methods.name: compset
methods.description: Set completion options such as pattern matching.

methods.name: _arguments
methods.description: Define command-line argument specifications for completers.

methods.name: _describe
methods.description: Describe a list of symbols for completion.
